He found a pen, wrote a short reply on the dry corner of the page, and set the bottle adrift again at the next low tide.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。高架桥上的路灯一排排亮着，像无人检阅的仪仗。清洁车缓缓驶过，水痕在沥青上拖出一道短暂的亮。便利店的门内，值夜的人靠着收银台打盹，关东煮的蒸汽在灯下打着旋。远处的写字楼还有几格窗亮着，那些不肯睡的人把自己钉在屏幕前。风从楼与楼之间穿过，带着一点夜班工厂的味道。天还没亮，但已经不那麼黑了，像有人在天边用很淡的铅笔轻轻描了一道。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves a small piece of itself and then asks a smaller copy of the same job to finish the rest.\n- It only works if there is a stopping point, like a staircase that ends at the floor instead of going down forever.\n- Think of nested dolls: open one, and inside is a slightly smaller version of the same thing, until you reach the tiny solid one that does not open."}
